answer.justification: All logit-level values fall in the system-prompted ranges: KL 0.265 (0.197–0.339), top-1 agreement 0.883 (0.861–0.908), sequence agreement 0.375 (0.31–0.48), TV 0.123 (0.108–0.144), Token-DiFR gap 0.419 (0.28–0.52), and raw-score shift ÷ TV 3.6 (3.3–3.9). Fine-tuned is ruled out mainly by KL, which is above the 0.205 maximum, and by TV, which is above the 0.099 maximum. Quantized and base are ruled out by the much larger KL and the lower top-1 agreement. Output and activation measurements were not available, so some uncertainty remains.
